messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE / Paging #incidents · SEV2 detected · region=ap-southeast2 (SYD) · symptom=cdn POP packet loss & DNS timeouts · affected-services=redwood-hosted-api, streaming-edge · triggered-by=monitoring.alerts.edge_packet_loss > 5% for 5m

oncall-net: taking pager. joining huddle now. @eng-sre-lead @netops-amy please ack. :phone:

eng-sre-lead: ack. grabbing network-side telemetry. are we seeing packetloss across all SYD POPs or single node?

netops-amy: looks like the syd-pop-02 interface to carrier-xyz is showing 15-30% packet loss from our eBPF probes, others healthy. DNS queries from clients to our edge are getting SERVFAILs intermittently.

infra-jake: confirmed. Cloud provider AZ-a has degraded internal routing — I see cross-AZ path flaps for 10.0.3.0/24. Provider ticket is open (CLD-78321).

support-alex: CS reporting multiple customers in AU seeing 503 and long tails for t=ListEmbeddings and text-generation. Spike in error-rate: 12% for ap-southeast2, 95th latency 2.3s -> 8.5s.

customer-success-maya: we have two enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, FinApps) on Dedicated routing via SYD. They're calling. Need ETA and mitigation.

eng-sre-lead: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Reroute traffic off syd-pop-02 -> syd-pop-01 via traffic-steer rule. 2) Failover DNS authoritative responses to secondary nameservers in sydney-backup region (ns2). 3) If carrier path remains flaky, steer global CDN edges to SG region as fallback.

oncall-net: executing step 1 now: applying steer via console policy "pop-evict-syd02-2234" with 30s TTL.

deploy-bot: roll started by oncall-net: steer/pop-evict-syd02-2234 -> 3 changes.

oncall-net: steer applied. monitoring shows initial drop in loss at 30s, but we're seeing >5% residual on some prefixes during slow convergence.

eng-sre-lead: running quick checks: posting traceroute from our healthbox to client prefixes and to provider transit.

eng-sre-lead: ```
# traceroute to 203.12.45.67 (client)
1  10.0.1.1  0.7 ms
2  192.168.5.1  1.2 ms
3  * * *   (loss at carrier-xyz agg)
4  203.12.45.67  40.3 ms
```

netops-amy: mtr from peering shows intermittent loss between our edge and carrier-xyz aggregate, high variance TTL. suspect transit link flapping at provider.

infra-jake: provider status page shows targeted maintenance in AZ-a  — they claim control-plane fix in progress. Ticket CLD-78321 updated: "engineers applying route dampening; expected stabilization 20-40m".

support-alex: customer impact: backend 5xx/errors for API keys routing via syd-pop-02 and increased tail latency for streaming sessions. Marking impacted customers in status page: short blurb ready if we confirm SG failover.

customer-success-maya: please confirm which customers are on Dedicated in SYD vs Hosted. I'll prepare customer comms for Dedicated first.

eng-sre-lead: oncall-net please list active sessions affected and estimate sessions to eject when we steer to sg-pop.

oncall-net: query: `SELECT count(*) FROM edge_sessions WHERE pop='syd-pop-02' AND last_active > now() - interval '10 minutes';` -> ~420 active sessions, 38 enterprise pinned routes. Expect graceful reconnect, but we'll need to coordinate sticky cookie purge for clients pinned to syd-02.

netops-amy: starting DNS mitigation: switch authoritative weight to ns2.syd-backup (TTL 30s). Doing in 2m.

eng-sre-lead: also enable aggressive retry/backoff on our edge-client balancer to reduce 503s during transient routing changes. Pushing config now.

eng-sre-lead: `kubectl -n edge patch cm client-balance --patch '{"data": {"retry_window":"3000"}}'` -> applied.

deploy-bot: configmap patch completed on 12 pods. Restart not required.

oncall-net: steering traffic away is reducing error-rate: now 6% -> trending down to 2.1% within 6m. Enterprise pinned routes still need manual update.

support-alex: CS: AcmeCorp wants guaranteed failover logs. Maya / eng-sre-lead can you confirm their pinned prefix list?

customer-success-maya: I have contacts on call. Will provide pinned prefixes and escalate if they see persistent errors after 10m.

eng-sre-lead: next steps: 1) finish DNS weight change 2) vendor escalation for provider CLD-78321 asking for permanent route dampening 3) update status.redwood.ai with impacted services + mitigation note 4) schedule follow-up postmortem if stabilizes > 30m.

netops-amy: DNS weight shifted, TTL propagated (30s). Monitoring shows SERVFAILs down by 80%.

infra-jake: provider reports route dampening applied. I'm seeing BGP flaps suppressed now. Keep monitoring for 30m.

oncall-net: traffic metrics: request error-rate now 1.8%, latency 95th 1.1s. Still watching.

eng-sre-lead: can someone open an incident page and note timelines + customer impact? I'll add interim RCA notes.

support-alex: incident page created: https://status.internal/inc/2234567890 (draft). Adding affected customers list and mitigation steps.

customer-success-maya: letting AcmeCorp and FinApps know we've routed around the bad path and are seeing improvement; offering follow-up call.

eng-sre-lead: handing to infra-jake for vendor follow-through and to document routing flap fingerprints. oncall-net you can standby for 30m then clear pager if stable.

infra-jake: vendor asked for traceroute logs and psuedo-headers — pushing full logs to CLD-78321.

oncall-net: copying logs to incident page and will remain on-call until 2244567890 (approx +3h) or until cleared.

incident-bot: UPDATE - SEV2 -> monitoring shows stable for 15m, impact reduced. Postmortem required.

eng-sre-lead: resolution notes (quick): root cause - transient provider AZ routing instability causing carrier path flaps and DNS SERVFAILs; mitigation - traffic steering off affected POP, DNS weight shift to backup nameserver, config tweak for retries; customer impact - 12% peak error-rate for ap-southeast2, affected enterprise pinned sessions addressed via manual reroute; follow-ups - vendor SLA review, add automated pop failover runbook, add health-check on carrier-agg links.

support-alex: closing comms with customers after 30m of stability.

customer-success-maya: thanks everyone. I'll schedule post-incident debrief with AcmeCorp ops for tomorrow 09:00 AEST.

eng-sre-lead: thanks team. oncall-net, infra-jake, netops-amy good job. clearing this thread when we hit 60m stable. :white_check_mark:
